endorsements.name: Besim Altinok
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-34024
endorsements.description: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the Edimax EW-7438RPn firmware version 1.13 and prior via the mp.asp form handler. The /goform/mp endpoint improperly handles user-supplied input to the command parameter. An authenticated attacker can inject shell commands using shell metacharacters to achieve arbitrary command execution as the root user. Exploitation evidence was observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-09-14 UTC.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.4)

endorsements.name: Besim Altinok
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-34029
endorsements.description: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini firmware version 1.13 and prior via the syscmd.asp form handler. The /goform/formSysCmd endpoint exposes a system command interface through the sysCmd parameter. A remote authenticated attacker can submit arbitrary shell commands directly, resulting in command execution as the root user. Exploitation evidence was observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-09-14 UTC.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.4)
